I can't confirm that. The evidence is insufficient for the full period (2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04) because of a gap at the end.

- **What was found:** NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting the property on the days covered. That covers MODIS and VIIRS NOAA-20 and NOAA-21 through 2026-11-03, and VIIRS SNPP through 2026-11-03 as well.
- **What's missing:** All four sensors lack coverage for 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04. The near-real-time data hadn't been updated past that point, because the day was in progress or not yet published.
- **Limits:** Even on covered days, no detection doesn't prove no fire. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. The evidence also says nothing about burned area or about any time outside the period.

In short, no fire detections were seen for nearly the whole period, but the final day isn't covered. Re-check once the latest data is published.
